2607.09641.title: Semantic Pareto-DQN: A Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Framework for Financial Anomaly Detection
2607.09641.paper_summary: Financial anomaly detection suffers from extreme class imbalance, causing traditional single-objective algorithms to exhibit ``fraud collapse'', defaulting to the majority class and failing to balance anomaly interdiction with customer friction. To overcome this without distortive data resampling, we propose the Semantic Pareto-DQN, a multi-objective reinforcement learning framework. Our approach synthesizes heterogeneous transaction features into cohesive natural-language narratives, encoded by large language models, thereby producing a robust, scale-invariant state representation. The agent optimizes a vectorial reward that explicitly decouples financial efficacy, operational friction, and semantic discovery. By mapping the continuous Pareto frontier, the system dynamically navigates the asymmetric costs of missed anomalies versus false positives. Empirical evaluations across E-Commerce fraud and UCI Credit datasets show that semantic Pareto-DQN successfully shatters the zero-recall trap. It achieves superior minority-class recall compared to scalarized baselines, providing an alternative to trade bounded operational friction for financial anomaly discovery.
2607.09641.paper_summary_zh: 金融異常檢測面臨極端的類別不平衡，導致傳統的單一目標演算法出現「詐騙崩潰」，偏向於多數類別，無法在異常攔截與客戶摩擦之間取得平衡。為了在不扭曲數據重採樣的情況下克服這一問題，我們提出了語義帕累托-DQN，一個多目標強化學習框架。我們的方法將異質的交易特徵合成為連貫的自然語言敘述，通過大型語言模型進行編碼，從而產生一個穩健的、尺度不變的狀態表示。該代理優化一個明確解耦金融效能、操作摩擦和語義發現的向量獎勵。通過映射連續的帕累托邊界，系統動態地導航錯過異常與假陽性之間的不對稱成本。在電子商務詐騙和UCI信用數據集上的實證評估顯示，語義帕累托-DQN成功打破了零召回陷阱。與標量基準相比，它在少數類別的召回率上表現優越，提供了一種替代方案，以在金融異常發現中權衡有限的操作摩擦。
